events.title: TFCH Demo Is Available Now!
events.summary: Hi guys! This Flash Contains Horrors is finally HERE! You can play LOOP and ROMASHKA today for free! LOOP – A short psychological horror game about a man who has lost control of his life. After being laid off, the main character tries to cope with despair through alcohol. With each passing day, reality becomes heavier, and his attempts to dull the pain only drag him further into a vicious cycle.
